report.explanation: All checkout requests returned 200 with mostly 60-80ms latency; one 344ms outlier. Traces show healthy downstream order, inventory, payment, postgres and redis spans with no errors. Metrics show zero 502s and no dependency failures. No evidence supports any taxonomy cause; the alert reflects a single slow request, not a fault.
missing_evidence: Baseline latency distribution for /v1/checkout to judge whether 344ms is anomalous
Sustained error-rate or timeout evidence for any downstream dependency
Resource saturation metrics (CPU, memory, connection pool) for gateway and downstream services
